prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency for all businesses — the right choice depends on what you need (digital ads, SEO, brand strategy, B2B demand gen, creative, etc.), your budget, industry, and preferred working style. I can help you find the best fit. A few quick questions will let me give a tailored shortlist:

- What services do you need (SEO, PPC, social, branding, web, content, PR, B2B demand gen, etc.)?
- What’s your monthly/annual marketing budget?
- Are you a local Maryland business only wanting a local agency, or open to remote/regional firms?
- Industry (tech, healthcare, nonprofit, retail, professional services, etc.)?
- Timeline / immediate goals (lead growth, awareness, product launch, fundraising, etc.)?
- Any must-haves (certifications, experience with HubSpot/Google/GDPR, in-house vs. outsourced)?

If you want to start searching on your own, these are the fastest ways to identify top Maryland agencies:
- Clutch.co and UpCity — filters for location, service, verified reviews and case studies.
- Google Maps / Google Reviews — for local agencies and client feedback.
- LinkedIn — look for agencies with client testimonials and team bios.
- Local business publications (Baltimore Business Journal) and chambers — news on award winners and spotlights.

How to evaluate and compare agencies:
- Ask for relevant case studies and measurable results (e.g., leads, revenue growth, CPA).
- Request client references and retention rates.
- Clarify reporting cadence, KPIs, and ownership of creative/assets.
- Understand pricing model (retainer, hourly, performance) and contract length.
- Check for transparency in tactics (no hidden ad spends or black-hat SEO).

If you want, tell me the answers to the questions above and I’ll compile a short, vetted list of Maryland agencies that match your needs (3–5 options, with specialties and why they fit). Which services/industry should I target?
